description: This is the main activity class for an Android application demonstrating managed profiles. It manages the setup and main fragment display based on whether the device profile is already configured.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for handling profile setup and main fragment display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, and decides which fragment to display based on profile ownership.

methods.name: showMainFragment
methods.description: Displays the main fragment for the managed profile.
